main_text.p: tiones ipsorum, quod naturâ notum est, neque hominibus omnibus imp tum;id Gentibus non potest sine tem tate imponi, & novæ creaturæ nor imperatum: sed certi alicujus dici heb madatim ---- appropriatio ad cult Dei solenniter, & cum vacatione in rim ab aliis operibus,Gentibus, sive f libus ex Gentilismo conversis,sine tem ritate imponi potest, & imperari no creaturæ. Sic enim factum est indè à mordiis Ecclefiæ Christianæ; & adhùc in Ecclefiâ Reformatâ: quam, siquis nomine temeritatis infimulare velit, eam defendimus, atque ampliùs per gratiam defendere parati sumus. Nunc Præmissis illis fiat Conclufio.

VII. Opponens addit: Præterea Deu pud Ezechielem xx, 10, 12. claris ver testatur, se in deserto dedisse populo S bata sua. Quod Deus in deserto dedit Ifr litis, id Abrahamo & aliis Patribus cu promissione non dedit. confer Nehe ıx, 14.
Resp. I. Locus Ezech. xx, 10, 11, fic habet: Itaque eduxi ipsos è terrá Ægyp

page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of most lines, so words are incomplete there and are shown only as far as they are visible. Some words at the left edge are partly hidden by the binding shadow and are read with uncertainty; these are not marked with [?] because the cut-off is a scanning fault. The lines "ıx, 14." and the start of "Resp." are read as printed. "Dedit Ifr" and similar cut words are visible fragments only.
